caption: The drawing features a detailed graphite rendering of a pitcher with a flared spout and a large, ornate handle. The pitcher is centrally placed within a rectangular frame. It has a bulbous middle section, a narrower base that flares outward, and a similarly flared rim. The body of the pitcher is decorated with two horizontal bands near its upper and lower sections. The drawing is shaded to convey the vessel’s rounded form and metallic or ceramic texture. In the lower left corner, there is a small inset drawing showing measurements and two views of the handle, one from the side and one from above. In the lower right corner, another small inset shows a front and side elevation of the pitcher with accompanying measurements. The composition uses only shades of gray on a light beige background, with fine lines and gradients to render form and detail. The name "MEYERS" is written in small text below the main pitcher illustration.
title: Pewter Pitcher
